[Story]
In a classroom of a middle school, teacher Wang is explaining different subjects. He says to student Liu, "We have 10 different courses, most are science courses, some are literature courses, but there are hardly any art courses." Liu flips through the schedule and finds only 3 art classes.

[Question]
Before Liu flips through the schedule, how many science classes does he guess?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Before Liu flips through the schedule, he guesses there are 9 science classes
B. Before Liu flips through the schedule, he guesses there are 3 science classes
C. Before Liu flips through the schedule, he guesses there are 10 science classes
D. Before Liu flips through the schedule, he guesses there are 8 science classes
